## Change

Describe the focused change.

## Why

Link the change request or bug and explain the need.

## Validation

List exact commands, builds, traces, and hardware tests. State clearly when no
physical hardware was tested.

## Compatibility and risk

Describe packet-format, persistence, flash-layout, board-support, DTR/RTS,
model, and performance-claim effects.

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and followed its evidence rules.
- [ ] I did not include credentials, private packets, or full device IDs.
- [ ] I updated documentation for changed behavior.
- [ ] I preserved raw benchmark evidence for performance claims.
- [ ] I distinguished build/simulation validation from physical hardware tests.
